title: Stage 0 v2.0.1 callers truth set: VS Code
built: 2026-11-07 by grep and reading. Disclosure: during development, before this file existed, code_index callers was run on RPCProtocol._remoteCall, AbstractKeybindingService._doDispatch, KeybindingResolver.resolve, ExtensionHostManager._createExtensionHostCustomers and extHostNamedCustomer as engine sanity checks; entries were not copied from that output.
method: whole-word search for the name over every .ts/.js file of a clean `git archive` of the commit (the hit count is recorded per symbol)
every hit read with its enclosing class or function; receivers traced to a declaration (new X(), a written type, a method's written return type, this in the class or a subclass)
symbols are the definitions named in the frozen VS Code questions (validation/v8/questions.json)
rule: A caller is a call site (file:line of the called name) that invokes this definition at run time: calls through imports, this/super in the class or a subclass that does not override it, static calls, decorator applications, and method calls on instances of the class even when the receiver's type is not written.

Not callers: the definition, imports, comments, strings, references that pass the function as a value (bind, invokeFunction), calls to other definitions with the same name (including overrides and interface members), which are listed as excluded or dynamic.
Tests and every other file in the tree count.
